docs.summary: How a value passed to [`AddForce`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rigidbody3D~AddForce) and friends is interpreted. The continuous modes accumulate for the next step; the instant ones change velocity straight away.
A continuous force in newtons. Heavier bodies accelerate less.
A continuous acceleration. Mass is ignored, so every body accelerates the same.
An instant change in momentum, in newton-seconds. Heavier bodies change velocity less.
An instant change in velocity. Mass is ignored.
